newsitem.title: USA: Key semiconductor index rises in Oct..
newsitem.headline: Key semiconductor index rises in Oct..

text.p: The semiconductor industry's key indicator rose to its highest level in nearly a year last month, a trade group reported on Monday, reflecting a surge in new orders for computer chips.

The Semiconductor Industry Association's book to bill ratio, which measures the value of orders against shipments, rose to 1.10 in October from a revised 0.98 in September. The ratio means manufactures received $110 in new orders last month for every $100 in shipments.
